question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Scintillating
solution: The correct answer is **"Dark."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Scintillating"** means sparkling or shining brightly. (चमचमाता या चमकता हुआ) • **Example**: *I can see the **scintillating**__ sun.* • **"Dark"** is the opposite of **scintillating.** • **"Dark"** means having very little or no light. (अँधेरा) __ • **Example**: *It was a **dark**__ night, with no moon.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Wonderful": **extremely good; fantastic. (अत्‍युत्तम, बहुत बढ़िया; आश्‍चर्यजनक, अद्‌भुत) • **"Bright": **extremely good; fantastic. (अत्‍युत्तम, बहुत बढ़िया; आश्‍चर्यजनक, अद्‌भुत) • **"Amazing": **very surprising and difficult to believe; incredible. (आश्‍चर्यजनक और अविश्‍वसनीय; अतिविस्‍मयकारी) 37:T836, The correct answer is **"A fair competition."**
